nh_white_share.label: White, not Hispanic
nh_white_share.source: U.S. Census Bureau, Population Estimates Program (Vintage 2025)
nh_white_share.note: Share of all residents. Modeled estimates; each new vintage revises back to 2020. Race groups are people who reported one race and are not Hispanic; Hispanic or Latino people can be of any race. The groups add to 100%.

female_share.source: U.S. Census Bureau, Population Estimates Program (Vintage 2025)
female_share.note: Share of all residents who are female. The Census Bureau counts sex (male or female); it does not publish gender identity by county. Modeled estimates; each new vintage revises back to 2020.

foreign_born_share.label: Residents born outside the U.S.
foreign_born_share.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates, table B05012
foreign_born_share.note: Foreign-born residents as a share of all residents: people who were not U.S. citizens at birth, including naturalized citizens, permanent residents, students, workers and others. People born in Puerto Rico, other U.S. territories or abroad to U.S.-citizen parents count as native-born. Survey estimate; ± is the 90% margin of error by the Census approximation for proportions.
